select (select count(id) from time_doser.base_user) as allUserSum, # 总用户数量
(select count(id) from time_doser.base_user where createdate between DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -1 DAY) and current_date) as userAdd, # 昨日新增用户
(select count(id) from time_doser.base_user where createdate between DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -2 DAY) and DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -1 DAY)) as exUserAdd, # 前天新增用户
(select count(distinct base_user_id) from time_doser.plan_task_history a left join time_doser.base_user b on a.base_user_id = b.id where b.createdate between DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -1 DAY) and current_date) as userAdd, # 昨日活跃账号统计
(select count(distinct base_user_id) from time_doser.plan_task_history a left join time_doser.base_user b on a.base_user_id = b.id where b.createdate between DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -2 DAY) and DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -1 DAY)) as userAdd, # 前天活跃账号统计
(select sum(tomato_work_time) from time_doser.plan_task_history where creat_time between DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -1 DAY) and current_date) as workSum, # 昨日学习时间统计
(select sum(tomato_work_time) from time_doser.plan_task_history where creat_time between DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -2 DAY) and DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -1 DAY)) as exWorkSum; # 前天学习时间统计
